body: RE-REVIEW HOLD on exact f849104, narrow test sufficiency only. Production eligibility logic is correct; the chartless negative court is non-vacuous and reverting structuralEligible to the old provider+unit predicate fails 0/1 with 0.9552238805970149 vs 0.8311688311688312. But the claimed charted positive control does NOT test eligibility. Independent mutation `val structuralEligible = false` leaves the existing positive test green 1/1: the Structural term is still present and total still differs because term production happens before eligibility. Measured exact candidate charted tuple: configured (support,total)=(0.9655172413793105,1.3558441558441556), absent=(0.961038961038961,1.3621621621621622). With structuralEligible=false: configured=(1.0,1.2), absent unchanged; every current positive assertion still passes. Add an assertion that kills this mutation, preferably literal configured support 0.9655172413793105 and total 1.3558441558441556 (with the existing preconditions/term-presence control), or an equally exact containment court. Then rerun focused gate. Scratch exact-candidate clone: /private/tmp/storymodel-cost-rereview.JCTmc4/repo. HOLD until the positive court proves eligibility rather than provider execution.
